text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. A birthday party by you, for 
you... it's finally complete!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. It's an "American-style birthday 
party" recommended by Pearl-sama and the 
others~♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! Really!? You're actually gonna throw 
a house party for me!?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Nice! ...That brings back so many 
memories! Gathering tons of friends for a 
birthday BBQ was something I looked 
forward to every year!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Indeed. I believe there was once a 
time when I carried a whole salmon to a 
friend's house party.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
When the invitation said 'No Raw Fish 
Allowed,' I ended up bringing a station 
bento instead, you know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~ that's right! The invitations~. 
Actually, the design drafts arrived 
today~.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Huuuuh? Let's have a look... wait. ...Huh? 
"Amusement park, private rental"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~! I heard that in American style, 
you're supposed to entertain your guests 
with all your might, so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So that everyone may enjoy themselves, I 
have decided to rent out "our family's" 
amusement park~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the event, we'll also be 
preparing eki-ben and BBQ in the park, so 
please look forward to it~♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What kind of scale is this...!? It's 
way beyond America, it's worldwide! It's 
just too global, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Bright! Your heart and 
brain are super big, YES!
